selection_context: Additional exploratory diagnostic after observing gains in the two fixed initial slices. It never replaces or pools with the original matrices, and is not an Open Babel comparison.
purpose: Check whole parse/write workflows on valid branched graphs that force the production size-8 ring search beyond the 32-atom inline boundary.

recipe.graph: One central C=C; each endpoint has two single-bonded identical balanced binary carbon subtrees of the declared depth. Every atom obeys ordinary carbon valence.
recipe.permutation: Rotate atom indices by variant*n//8; reverse the rotated order for odd variants. Retain every record, including equivalent permutations.
recipe.coordinates: x=index/2; y=(index%7)/4; z=0, in angstrom; 2D conformer
recipe.producer: Pinned existing RDKit 2026.09.1; MolToMolBlock(forceV3000=True); no input filtering.

order: Alternating baseline13/candidate14 native fresh processes; unchanged source-only diagnostic timer/bootstrap functions.
gates: Every generated molecule sanitizes in RDKit; both source arms have byte-identical native snapshots and rewrites; RDKit accepts every source canonical graph and rewrite, preserving the generated graph and name. Any failure blocks speed ranking for this diagnostic; no record is removed.
adoption: Retain every outcome. A newly observed clear regression is an additional limitation and must be evaluated against the fixed-workload gains, never hidden. No recursive retesting or pooling.
